question: Does a language-free SERA retain accuracy, and do three decoder experts improve over two?
initial_checks: C/R/S/U at 12 hours, both seeds, followed by the remaining cells regardless of effect sign
language_free_training: Train the temporal encoder and all decoder stages from random initialization or their own language-free preceding stage. No semantic features, reliability models or language-trained weights enter this pipeline.
data_reuse: Reuse only data-derived origins, target indices, labels, window statistics and scaled numerical covariates. Reconstruct target histories from source files. Never load old trained latent features into language-free training.
independent_reference_reuse: Reuse each audited DLinear checkpoint; it was trained from target histories alone.
decoder_comparison_scope: Identical language-free frozen encoder and fully fitted decoder initialization; one matched additional decoder fit per retained expert set. These are decoder ablations, not four independently pretrained whole systems.
outputs: all stage checkpoints with optimizer/RNG and epoch recovery
raw per-origin predictions and target indices
selection: No test-driven tuning. Compare frozen configurations; select any proposed simplification using mean task-relative development MAE, with differences within 0.1 percentage point resolved toward fewer output experts. Test results are reported separately.
test_status: The historical benchmark periods were viewed in previous research; this is not a new independent holdout.
